cards.body: Whether you run a restaurant, tattoo shop, salon, or service business—we shape your website around your photos, colors, menu or portfolio, and story. One polished place that looks like you, not a generic template.
We publish clear starting prices and confirm the full scope in writing before work begins. No hidden fees and no pressure—just an honest quote so you can decide in your own time.
Once you send your photos, wording, and logo, we work at your speed—not a rigid agency calendar. Need to move quickly? We can. Want time to review? No rush. We agree on timing before we start.
Your site is laid out for real phones—easy tap-to-call, hours, directions, and menus or galleries that are simple to scroll. The basics done properly so visitors know how to reach you.

Your site comes with a built-in CMS, so you can change your menu, prices, hours, and photos yourself whenever you want—no monthly plan and no waiting on me. Need a bigger change like a new page? Send it over and I'll quote it first.
Share a few details and we'll schedule a short Zoom call. No hard sell—just an honest conversation about what you need, what it costs, and whether we're a good fit.

cards.title: Your brand in one place
cards.body: Your logo, photos, menu or portfolio, hours, and story—organized so new customers see who you are at a glance. A home online that reflects the care you put into your work.

cards.title: Built for how people actually look you up
cards.body: Most people check you out on their phone first. We build for that—clear layout, tap-to-call, and the details they need in one easy place.

cards.title: Ready for Google and your Maps listing
cards.body: We set up the fundamentals—clear page titles, descriptions, and a proper link from your Google Business Profile—so when someone searches for what you offer, they land somewhere that represents you well.

framework.title: A proven layout. Your unique brand.
paragraphs: Every Halite site starts from layouts we've refined on real projects—then we customize your colors, photos, wording, and goals so it feels unmistakably yours. A clean, custom site built around your business—not a generic template.

The result loads quickly on phones, looks professional, and gives visitors a clear path to call, message, or visit. We keep the process simple so you can stay focused on running your shop—not learning web technology.
framework.emphasis: Founding rates start at $500 for a Starter site and $750 for a Full site—we confirm your exact price before any work begins.

localBusinessCta.body: Free 20-minute Zoom—or call Sebastian directly. We'll look at what you have now, suggest what fits, and give you an honest price. No jargon, no pressure.

founder.title: Hi, I'm Sebastian.
founder.name: Sebastian Salgado
founder.imageAlt: Sebastian Salgado, founder of Halite WebDev
paragraphs: I started Halite WebDev because I wanted local businesses to have a website they could feel proud of—one that looks like them, loads well on phones, and makes it easy for customers to get in touch.

Whether you run a restaurant, tattoo shop, salon, or service business, we treat your site as your branding hub online: your photos, your menu or portfolio, your hours, your story. I listen first, keep pricing clear, and build something that represents the care you put into your work.

Halite is intentionally small. When you work with us, you work directly with me—the person building your site. We'll give you honest answers, confirm the price before we start, and won't sell you things you don't need.

privacy.intro: Halite WebDev ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your choices. We are a small studio operated by Sebastian Salgado in Las Cruces, New Mexico.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you contact us through our website form, email, or phone, we may collect your name, business name, email address, phone number, website or social links you provide, and any message you send us.

When we build or host your website, we may also process business content you provide (text, images, logos) and basic analytics data such as page views and device type, if analytics are enabled on your site.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use your information to respond to inquiries, provide quotes, build and maintain your website, send invoices, and deliver ongoing website care if you subscribe to a maintenance or monthly plan.
We do not sell your personal information. We do not use your data for unrelated advertising.

sections.heading: Form submissions
paragraphs: Our contact form is delivered through a third-party form service (FormSubmit) that forwards submissions to our email. That provider may process submission data according to its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: Hosting and client sites
paragraphs: Client websites may be hosted through third-party providers (such as Vercel or similar services). Those providers process technical data (IP addresses, request logs) as part of normal hosting operations.
If your site includes a contact form, form submissions may be processed by the form provider configured for your project.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep client project files, contracts, and correspondence as long as needed to provide services and meet legal or accounting obligations. You may request deletion of non-essential personal data after your project ends, subject to records we must retain.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you by emailing salsalgadonm@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy: Sebastian Salgado, Halite WebDev, Las Cruces, NM — salsalgadonm@gmail.com or (505) 373-9851.

service-agreement.intro: This page summarizes key terms for Halite WebDev website projects and monthly plans. A signed agreement may include additional details. This summary is provided for transparency before you hire us.

sections.heading: Parties and scope
paragraphs: Halite WebDev (Sebastian Salgado) provides website design, development, hosting setup, and domain connection for small businesses.
You (the "Client") provide business information, content, photos, logos, and timely feedback needed to complete the project.

sections.heading: Upfront (pay-once) projects
paragraphs: For upfront packages, you pay the agreed project fee according to the payment schedule in your quote (typically a deposit to start and balance before or at launch). Founding rates: Starter site $500, Full site $750 unless otherwise quoted.

Every build includes the DIY Handoff at no extra cost: your complete site files, written instructions, a live 1-hour walkthrough, and access to the built-in CMS so you can update your own text and photos. There is no monthly plan and no subscription.
You must register and own your domain name; Halite does not purchase domains on your behalf. You share registrar access so we can connect your site.
Larger changes (new pages, redesigns, major photo work) are quoted separately.

sections.heading: Monthly financing (6- or 12-month term)
paragraphs: Monthly financing splits the same one-time build price over a 6- or 12-month term to make it easier to get online. It is a payment plan, not a subscription—there are no ongoing hosting or care fees included, and no lock-in after the term.
Starter site financing: $85/month for 6 months, or $45/month for 12 months. Full site financing: $130/month for 6 months, or $65/month for 12 months. Exact terms are stated in your quote.
You may pay off the remaining balance early at any time. Once the financed price is paid in full, the site is yours and nothing further is owed.
If you stop payments before the price is paid off, you remain responsible for the remaining build balance as stated in your signed agreement.

sections.heading: Updating your site yourself
paragraphs: Every site includes a built-in CMS so you can change your own text and photos anytime—hours, prices, a new photo, a menu item, and similar updates—without paying for edits.
Larger changes such as new pages, redesigns, e-commerce setup, or copywriting from scratch are not self-service and are quoted separately.
If you'd rather I make a change for you, send it over and I'll quote it first. Turnaround is typically 3–5 business days unless otherwise agreed.

sections.heading: Ownership and handoff
paragraphs: You own the content you provide (your words, logos, photos) and must register your domain in your own name with a third-party registrar. Halite does not take legal ownership of your domain.
Halite builds custom websites tailored to your business—lightweight, fast on phones, and straightforward to maintain.

For upfront projects paid in full, you receive your complete site files plus written instructions to redeploy or transfer to another host. The DIY Handoff—including the live 1-hour walkthrough and CMS access—is included at no extra charge.
For financed projects, full ZIP handoff is available once the financed price is paid in full or upon early payoff.
You always receive your site files and reasonable handoff notes. A migration fee may apply for extra hand-holding beyond the standard export.

sections.heading: Client responsibilities
paragraphs: You agree to provide accurate business information, respond to requests within a reasonable time, and ensure you have rights to any images or content you supply.
Delays in client feedback may shift launch timelines. We are not responsible for launch delays caused by missing content or approvals.

sections.heading: Solo operator disclosure
paragraphs: Halite WebDev is operated by Sebastian Salgado as an individual studio. You work directly with the builder. Support is provided during reasonable business hours—not 24/7 emergency response unless explicitly agreed as a paid add-on.

sections.heading: Payment and late fees
paragraphs: Invoices are due on the date stated. Late payments may pause work, hosting, or support until the account is current.
Monthly plans are billed automatically when card billing is set up, or by invoice when agreed.

sections.heading: Questions
paragraphs: Before signing, ask anything that is unclear. Contact: salsalgadonm@gmail.com or (505) 373-9851. We're happy to walk through this in plain language on a short call.
